lessons.title: Past routines with the imperfect
lessons.objective: Past routines with the imperfect: Use the imperfect for past habits or background: estudiaba, comía, vivía.

words.es: Antes vivía cerca de la escuela.
words.en: I used to live near the school.
I used to study Spanish in the afternoon.
Ana used to walk to the library.
We used to eat together on Fridays.
Now we live in another city.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Antes y ahora with a patient classmate. Practice past routines with the imperfect. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

lessons.title: Por and para: first contrasts
lessons.objective: Por and para: first contrasts: Para often marks purpose, recipient or destination.

words.en: I study in order to learn Spanish.
I am heading toward the library.

words.es: La tienda está cerrada por la lluvia.
words.en: The store is closed because of the rain.

lessons.title: Connect ideas and review
lessons.objective: Connect ideas and review: Y adds an idea, pero contrasts it, porque explains a reason, and entonces signals a result or next step.

words.es: Quiero estudiar, pero la biblioteca está cerrada.
words.en: I want to study, but the library is closed.

words.es: Ana tiene un libro y dos cuadernos.
words.en: Ana has a book and two notebooks.

words.es: Vamos al café porque está abierto.
words.en: We are going to the café because it is open.

words.es: Luis no tiene dinero, entonces Ana lo invita.
words.en: Luis has no money, so Ana treats him.

words.es: Estudiamos una hora y después caminamos a casa.
words.en: We study for an hour and then walk home.
Tomorrow we are going to review together.
